About Me

AI creativity meets design discipline

I'm Kajal Dhakrey, an AI Creator, Video Editor and Graphic Designer based in Agra, India — passionate about combining creativity with AI technology. I create AI-generated visuals, videos, animations, thumbnails, social media creatives and marketing content.

I also work with freelance clients, helping them turn their ideas into professional and engaging visual content. My goal is to build creative digital experiences and grow as an AI-focused creator and entrepreneur.
